newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ FEC wants earlier budget policy statement.
newsitem.headline: NZ FEC wants earlier budget policy statement.

text.p: Parliament's Finance and Expenditure select committee on Wednesday urged the government to look at publishing the Budget Policy Statement earlier.
The BPS, which describes the government's broad fiscal strategy, must be published annually before March 31.

"We recommend that the government examine the feasibility of publishing the statement significantly earlier and allowing more time for the select committee consideration of the statement," the committee said in its report to parliament.
Treasurer Winston Peters has said the budget will be in June although he would prefer a May Budget in future years.
Because of the short timeframe for submissions and the committee's deliberations, business and union groups have questioned the relevance of the committee's work on the BPS.
